name: gmo-onair
description: GMO ONAiR - 統合業務管理システム

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,equipment,qsheet,interactive,techsheet,live,server -c blue,cyan,magenta,yellow,white,red,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w client-equipment" "npm run dev -w client-qsheet" "npm run dev -w client-interactive" "npm run dev -w client-techsheet" "npm run dev -w client-live" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-equipment && npm run build -w client-qsheet && npm run build -w client-interactive && npm run build -w client-techsheet && npm run build -w client-live && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:render: cd client && npx vite build && cd ../client-equipment && npx vite build && cd ../client-qsheet && npx vite build && cd ../client-interactive && npx vite build && cd ../client-techsheet && npx vite build && cd ../client-live && npx vite build && cd ../server && npx tsc && mkdir -p dist/shared/db && cp -r src/shared/db/migrations dist/shared/db/
